description:
Orion is a 48ft Al Shaali flybridge motor yacht available for private charter in Dubai, offering three levels, an elegant layout and a stylish lounge.

She welcomes up to 12 guests, has one cabin and is run by a professional crew of 1. Departing from Dubai Marina, she is a great choice for couples, families and small groups, with routes past Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm Jumeirah and the Burj Al Arab.

Charters are available by the hour, for sunset cruises or for the full day. Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
